title: carbon-capture-greybox-empc: Code for "Neural network-based Grey-box Modeling and Economic Model Predictive Control of a Solvent-based Carbon Capture Pilot Plant"
description:
Julia code to reproduce the results of the paper Neural network-based Grey-box Modeling and Economic Model Predictive Control of a Solvent-based Carbon Capture Pilot Plant (E. S. Martinsen, S. Frandsen, T. Scharling, J. K. Møller, H. Madsen, T. K. S. Ritschel, G. Goranović; submitted to Journal of Process Control; preprint: 10.2139/ssrn.7329166).

The code covers the full pipeline: processing of the raw pilot-plant logs from the DTI carbon capture pilot plant, parameter estimation of the neural network-based grey-box model, EKF-based model validation, steady-state analysis, an offline replay of the closed-loop economic MPC tests, and the evaluation of the EMPC demonstration. The data are published separately on DTU Data.
